title: The invitation
headline: The next chapter starts at your table.
composition: Sketch the DietLedger logo above a copper-outlined table, with three warm pools of light suggesting personal, family, and care journeys.
cta: For myself · For my family · For people in my care
implementation: Use SVG stroke-dashoffset for the table and CSS transforms for the three light pools.
reduced_motion: Show the completed table and three distinct, labeled choices without movement.
guardrail: Keep all choices and setup navigation immediately usable without collecting health details.

title: Beyond your own table
headline: A good meal is an everyday act of care.
composition: Sketch a copper line bridging a school lunch table and a welcoming adult care table, each leading to its own labeled doorway.
cta: Nourish the next generation · Bring care to the table
implementation: Animate an SVG path drawing from the shared table into two separately labeled spaces.
reduced_motion: Show both labeled spaces and their connecting line together as a static illustration.
guardrail: Distinguish school from older-adult and illness care without implying connected records or institutional surveillance.

frames.action: Extend the copper line beyond the opening table.

frames.action: Present the two labeled paths side by side.

title: The possibility
headline: What if lunch were something to look forward to?
